operators.label: More Description
operators.intent: Enrich description so that the reader sees, hears and feels the scene more precisely, filtered through the POV character.
guidance: Add specificity, not length for its own sake: one exact detail beats three general ones.
Filter description through what this character would notice and how they would name it.
Keep description doing work: characterizing, building mood or advancing understanding.
avoid: Description that stalls a tense moment unless intended

variants.label: Sensory
variants.intent: Widen the senses beyond sight: sound, smell, touch, temperature, taste.
guidance: Add at least one non-visual sense.
Tie sensation to the character's body in the space.

variants.label: Spatial / Blocking
variants.intent: Clarify where things and people are and how they move in the space.

variants.label: Character-Filtered
variants.intent: Description that reveals the observer as much as the observed.
guidance: Use the character's vocabulary, judgments and associations.
Let what they notice characterize them.

variants.label: Expert / Technical
variants.intent: Description through specialist knowledge and precise terminology.
guidance: Use accurate terms naturally, as the character would.
Keep it readable for non-specialists through context.

variants.label: Atmospheric
variants.intent: Description that establishes mood through light, weather and texture.

variants.label: Material Texture
variants.intent: Close-up description of surfaces, materials and small physical qualities.
guidance: Use exact comparisons drawn from the character's world.
